run_swag_training: run BERT fine-tuning on the SWAG multiple-choice dataset with training and evaluation
read_swag_examples: read SWAG dataset CSV files into SwagExample objects for training or evaluation
convert_examples_to_features: convert SWAG examples into BERT InputFeatures with tokenized choices and labels
evaluate_swag_model: evaluate a fine-tuned BERT multiple-choice model on the SWAG validation set
save_trained_model: save a trained BERT model checkpoint, config, and tokenizer to an output directory
